raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Exuma from Greek exō (outside) + -ma (result noun); exōma = that which is outside, an outer garment",
    "reading": "That which lies outside the garment — the exposed, the exoteric surface",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "Liddell & Scott, Greek-English Lexicon",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Ex + uma; ex (Latin) = out of; uma (Portuguese) = one (feminine); ex-uma = out of one",
    "reading": "Emerging from unity — the one that becomes many",
    "languages": ["la", "pt", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Exuma ~ ex humo (Latin) = from the earth; humus = ground",
    "reading": "Born of the soil — chthonic origin, earth‑risen",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Exuma → amuxe (anagram); amuxe ~ amussis (Latin) = rule, level; also amux = a hook",
    "reading": "The level and the hook — measure and grasp, the tool of the builder",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "E‑X‑U‑M‑A: Ex, X (unknown), Umbra (shadow), Mater (mother), A (alpha) — out of the unknown shadow, the mother is the beginning",
    "reading": "From the dark matrix of the unknown, the first principle is born",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "E (Greek epsilon = 5, also 'he' breath) + X (chi = cross) + U (vessel) + M (water, mem) + A (alpha = beginning)",
    "reading": "Breath‑cross‑vessel‑water‑beginning: the alchemical bath of creation",
    "languages": ["grc", "he", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Exuma in Greek isophony: E=5, X=600, U=400, M=40, A=1 → 1046; 1+0+4+6=11; 11 = the master number, the threshold",
    "reading": "The sum 1046 reduces to 11 — the door between worlds, the initiate's passage",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Ex + uma; uma (Sanskrit) = flax, also name of Parvati; ex‑uma = from the goddess of the mountain",
    "reading": "Issued from the divine feminine — the mountain‑born, the subtle fibre",
    "languages": ["sa", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Exuma ~ ekso (Greek) = outside + ma (Japanese) = space; ekso‑ma = outer space",
    "reading": "The outer room — the cosmos beyond the hearth",
    "languages": ["grc", "ja", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Exuma from Latin exuere = to strip off, to divest; exu‑ma = the act of shedding",
    "reading": "The casting off of skin — the serpent's molt, the soul's undressing",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "Lewis & Short, Latin Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.8
  }
]
